newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan says needs to narrow interest rate gap.
newsitem.headline: Japan says needs to narrow interest rate gap.

text.p: Japan's chief government spokesman said on Tuesday that the interest rate gap between Japan and other countries should be narrowed.

"Our interest rates (on deposits) are the lowest compared to other countries with the exception of Switzerland. However, looking at companies, rates (on borrowing) are higher compared to other countries. As part of the internationalisation component of the current reforms, we need to raise the low things and lower the high things," Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama told a key parliamentary committee.
He added that Japanese financial institutions may be threatened by foreign institutions, but the interests of the Japanese public will be protected.
